acceptanceCriteria: Root cause of the 'observer descendants never started' failure identified (deadline vs runner load, or the observer exiting before spawning)
The test's startup wait is bounded by a load-tolerant deadline or the observer's own readiness signal, and the fix is proven under -race with CPU contention
body: Suspected flake (not confirmed bug): TestAFUV0NoDescendantsOnInterruption (internal/appflows/observer_unix_test.go:74) failed on hosted ubuntu in run 39357611388 job 118416710971 (batch PR #1268, shard 4, 2026-10-20T02:19Z) with 'observer descendants never started' after 10.55s. Batch #1268 does not touch internal/appflows. Distinct failure mode from V1-1363 (descendants survived interruption). The child.pid/grandchild.pid files never both appeared before the deadline. Failed jobs rerun.
title: Suspected flake: TestAFUV0NoDescendantsOnInterruption reports 'observer descendants never started' on hosted ubuntu (PR #1268 shard 4)
